title: Design: Classification No Charge lists only no-charge work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have one open internal work order, one open no-charge work order and one billable work order.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow4-02-02-list-no-charge.png, iwo-happy-38-38-work-orders-list-classification.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Pick No Charge in the Classification chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every row is listed.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Classification: No Charge" and only the no-charge work order is listed, with its No Charge badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R14: “While the Internal Work Orders setting is on, the work orders list shows a chip "Classification: All / Billable / Internal / No Charge" (the existing single-choice chip), default All, on every tab and in the mobile filter sheet. While the setting is off the chip is not shown; the badges on the rows stay.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
